title: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5, a cheaper AI model for coding, agents and enterprise workflows
summary: Anthropic acknowledges Opus 5 remains behind Mythos 5 , a competing model, on cybersecurity tasks and biology research, and an OpenAI-family model still leads on one agentic coding benchmark. That is the context in which Opus 5's pricing strategy makes sense.
